name: plan-tooling-change-boundary
body: Non-goal boundary (prose; assessed by review): this change-set makes no change to the `apg` binary (no `src/**` Rust) and no change to suite tools other than `apg_plan_phases`. It is confined to `opencode-suite/tools/apg_plan_phases.ts`, the shared `opencode-suite/lib/apg.ts` helper that tool uses, and their suite tests (`opencode-suite/lib/apg.test.ts`, `opencode-suite/tests/boundary.e2e.test.ts`). The binary's graph, plan and verify behaviour is untouched; the shared-lib change must be additive and must not alter the behaviour of any other suite tool.
